Frequently asked questions

Plan the tools, infill, supports, finish, hardware, and finished opening before assembly.

These answers cover the five core gate-frame questions plus included components, infill selection, non-combustible aluminum, measurements, and custom design.

What tools do I need to assemble this gate kit?

The core gate-frame components are designed for straightforward field assembly. Standard hand tools such as a drill, wrench, tape measure, square, and level are typically used. No specialized fabrication equipment is required for the frame assembly.

Can I use this gate frame with my existing fence panels?

The frame is compatible with 3/4-inch or 1-inch profile infill. Existing panels or custom infill can work when their dimensions, weight, fastening method, and layout are appropriate for the 6×6 frame.

Is the aluminum frame durable for outdoor use?

Yes. The frame is made from 6063-T6 aluminum and finished with black powder coating for exterior use. Aluminum is corrosion resistant and does not develop iron-oxide rust.

Can this gate be installed by a DIYer?

Yes. The kit is designed for DIY assembly using precut frame sections, strong connectors, the included side-post and T-stopper components, and heavy-duty hinges. Accurate opening measurements, squareness, hinge alignment, and safe handling are still important.

Does this kit include lock hardware or posts for concrete footing?

Lock hardware and concrete footing are not included. For a concrete installation, confirm the appropriate heavy-duty post or support upgrade before ordering.

What is included with the 6×6 frame kit?

The package includes two vertical gate-frame members, top and bottom gate-frame sections, the 2-inch by 1-inch side-post configuration identified for this product, the L-shaped receiver or side-post component with T stopper, one set of heavy-duty double-support hinges, and the black powder-coated aluminum frame components.

What infill can I use with the frame?

The frame is intended for compatible 3/4-inch or 1-inch profile infill. Depending on the complete design, that can include compatible aluminum profiles or another properly engineered infill material.

Is the aluminum non-combustible?

The 6063-T6 aluminum frame material is non-combustible. Complete Zone Zero, wildfire, pool-barrier, or other code compliance depends on the full assembly, placement, openings, hardware, and local requirements.

What should I measure before ordering?

Confirm the finished opening width and height, wall or post conditions, hinge side, latch or stop condition, swing clearance, grade, selected infill thickness, and the complete support plan before ordering.

Can the frame be used for a custom gate design?

Yes. The frame-only format is specifically useful when the builder wants to choose the infill pattern and finished appearance while starting from a coordinated aluminum gate structure.

A boxed 4x6 horizontal aluminum gate kit for a single-swing pedestrian gate: the DIY gate frame kit, 16 pre-cut ALU 40 slats (39in.) and 7/8 plugs, finished with AAMA 2604 powder coating.

A boxed 4x6 horizontal aluminum gate kit for walk-through openings

This 4×6 horizontal aluminum gate kit packs everything needed for the gate leaf itself into one order: a DIY gate frame kit, a box of pre-cut ALU 40 slats and the 7/8 plugs that finish them. It is sized for a single-swing pedestrian gate – a side-yard entrance, a garden path or a service opening – and the slats sit horizontally with a 3/8" gap for a clean, modern line that matches horizontal fencing.

Because the slats arrive cut to 39in. for this frame, there is no need to measure and cut long profiles on site. You assemble the frame, fit the slats and add the plugs. Everything is made from 6063-T6 aluminum and finished with AAMA 2604 super-durable powder coating, so the gate will not rot, warp or need repainting the way a wood gate does.

The frame kit itself is listed with a vertical gate frame, vertical gate frame cap, top and bottom horizontal gate frame, 2 heavy duty hinges and a gate stopper, and it is compatible with the Universal Slat Adapter. Latches and posts are not part of the kit.

Why the ALU 40 slat with a 3/8" gap

ALU 40 is a 4-inch horizontal slat profile. The wider face means fewer visual lines across the gate than narrow slats, which gives the finished gate a more substantial, architectural look. The 3/8" spacing keeps the gate semi-private: neighbours see a solid-looking surface from most angles, while light and air still pass through. If you need full privacy with no gaps, look at the Alu 60 tongue-and-groove version of this kit instead.

Choosing posts for your DIY aluminum gate kit

Posts are sold separately because every opening is different. The price list offers five post options for this gate kit:

  • Hinge Post + L-Side Post – wall-to-wall installation
  • 3.15 Post – wall and concrete footing
  • 2-way post – wall mount only
  • 3in HD Post – concrete footing
  • 4in HD Post – standalone post

Between two existing walls, the 2x2in Hinge Post & L-Side Post Kit is the dedicated wall-to-wall option. For a gate set in the ground, a 3×3 in. HD square post is listed for concrete footing, and a 4in HD post is the standalone choice. The price list notes the 2.75 2-way post option is intended for gates up to 3 feet wide or wall mount, so confirm with our team whether it suits a 4 ft gate before choosing it.

Planning your order

Before you order, measure the finished opening, decide how each side will be fixed (wall, concrete footing or standalone post) and check your local code for any rules on gate hardware and height. Compare your measurements with the 4 ft x 6 ft kit size, including the space the posts will take up. If the numbers are close, send them to our team and we will confirm the right size.

Kits are listed in Black, Bronze and White. Some colours in this kit family are marked coming soon, so check the colour selector or confirm availability with our team before you plan around a specific finish. Need a wider opening? Compare the 6×6 ALU 40 gate kit or browse all aluminum gates.

ALU 40 black slat pedestrian gate project

Why a boxed kit instead of individual parts

Buying the frame, slats and plugs as one boxed kit removes the guesswork of matching slat length and quantity to the frame. It is the simplest route for homeowners building their first gate, and it saves contractors from cutting and sorting parts on site. Follow the included instructions and your local code during installation, and contact our team if anything about your opening is unusual.

Frequently asked questions

Answers before you assemble the ALU40 gate.

Review common questions about DIY assembly, gate sizing, finish, kit contents, mounting conditions and exterior use.

Can I install the ALU40 Universal DIY 4′ × 6′ Gate Kit BLACK by myself?

Yes. The kit is designed for DIY users. Components are pre-sized and engineered for straightforward assembly with no welding required.

Is the gate frame already sized or do I need to cut anything?

The gate frame comes pre-sized for the 4×6 configuration, so the frame itself does not require cutting. Follow the supplied slat and assembly instructions for the infill.

Can one person install the gate, or do I need assistance?

One person can assemble the frame, but an extra helper is useful during leveling and mounting so the gate can be positioned more quickly and precisely.

Do I need to paint or coat the gate after installation?

No. The black finish is already powder coated for durability, corrosion resistance and long-term color performance.

What exactly is included in this 4×6 kit?

This 4×6 configuration includes the Universal DIY frame, wide lock side, top and bottom frame, T-stopper, receiver L-stopper side post, one 5-inch HD support hinge and eight 4-inch × 6-foot ALU40 slats.

Can this gate be installed with posts set in concrete?

The standard specification is wall-to-wall only. The product page states that a concrete-footing installation requires an HD post upgrade that must be requested.

Does the kit include the lock or self-closing spring?

No. Lock hardware and the hydraulic self-closing spring are listed as not included. Select those parts based on the access-control and self-closing requirements of the project.

Is the aluminum gate suitable for coastal or humid climates?

Yes. The product is specifically listed for coastal, humid and harsh climates. Routine cleaning is still recommended where salt or environmental deposits accumulate.
